question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Final query with rounded avg_payment_value
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_payments AS (
    SELECT do2.order_id, SUM(op.payment_value) as total_payment
    FROM delivered_orders do2
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON do2.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY do2.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT do2.order_id) as delivered_order_count,
        AVG(op2.total_payment) as avg_payment_value,
        ANY_VALUE(c.customer_city) as customer_city,
        ANY_VALUE(c.customer_state) as customer_state
    FROM delivered_orders do2
    JOIN olist_customers c ON do2.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_payments op2 ON do2.order_id = op2.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    ROUND(avg_payment_value, 2) as avg_payment_value,
    customer_city,
    customer_state
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 3
